objective.purpose: Choose a supportable bounded course of action
objective.non_object: Maximize completed tasks or agent calls
objective.success_condition: The owner can reconstruct evidence, alternatives, limits and conservation
constraints: No external actions; synthetic data only

claims.statement: Synthetic decision premise; not external evidence
Synthetic decision premise; not external evidence

brief: A material decision needs a bounded course of action. Test the causal claim behind the leading option, trace whether its evidence comes from independent sources, and integrate both into one decision with stated limits and what would change it.
